in_arabic.name: Aryano
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Mountain man, hero, noble
in_arabic.long_meaning: Aryano هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic and Persian words 'Arya' (noble, man of honor) and 'An' (mountain), Aryano means mountain man or hero. This name is perfect for a boy who embodies strength, courage, and nobility.
